content_record.title: Cannabinoid receptor 2 activation locks breast cancer cells into a differentiated, therapy-sensitive state
content_record.editorial_body: Brief, low-dose CB2R agonists trigger an epigenetic switch that curbs plasticity and boosts tamoxifen response in organoid models. Three things to remember - CB2R activation induces basal-to-luminal transition, reducing self-renewal and invasiveness. - Differentiation persists under stress conditions that normally promote dedifferentiation. - Epigenetic stabilization enhances tamoxifen sensitivity and limits resistant clone emergence. Source This signal is based on CB2R-induced differentiation epigenetically restrains cancer plasticity enabling adaptive therapy from biorxiv. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Preclinical organoid study; human efficacy and safety not established.
